messages:
marta-sales: Hi team — customer (ZenLedger) asked for our compliance bundle + pen-test letter. Can we do a dry-run handoff tomorrow so their procurement can validate? Need to confirm what's safe to share and whether Dedicated pricing changes if they want on‑prem later. TL;DR: dry-run + quote impact.

dan-security: Yep. What exactly do they need? SOC2 Type II report, control matrix, network diagram, pen-test letter? Who signs the pen-test letter?

marta-sales: They listed: SOC2 attestation, pen-test attestation letter, ISO27001 cert excerpt (if available), network topology + list of third-party subprocessors, and staging IPs. Also want confirmation on KMS separation. They need the pen-test letter with signature and scope (external infra + app).

alex-ps: Pricing: if they require Dedicated / single-tenant we may need to move them to a reserved commit — that will change T&Cs. Need to know expected RPS and retention to quote. If it's just evidence for a PoC, Dedicated might not be required.

emma-legal: For pen-test letter we have a template. We can sign but legal needs the scope to be precise. Also need redaction rules for customer PII in attachments. I'll review once Dan posts proposed scope.

dan-security: I can put together the scope. For evidence transfer we prefer presigned S3 or secure share. Example presign command:

curl -X PUT "https://s3.amazonaws.com/our-bucket/staging/zenledger-evidence.zip?X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&X-Amz-Expires=3600" -T ./evidence.zip

I'll redact IPs where needed. Also pen-test letter signer will be our security director.

deploy-bot: artifact upload: staging/zenledger-evidence-dryrun.zip uploaded by dan-security at 2025-06-15T10:12:00Z :package:

marta-sales: Great — can you include a short checklist in the bundle indicating which artifacts are redacted and why? Procurement likes a map. Also need an estimate of how many hours for legal/security to prep this so we can decide on whether to bill the PoC.

dan-security: Checklist added. Rough estimate: 3-6 hours to assemble + 1 hour legal review. Pen-test letter turnaround depends on signature queue, probably same day if we prioritize.

alex-ps: Noted. If Dedicated asked later, pricing delta could be ~20-40% depending on commit length. I'll prepare a provisional quote but need expected qps and retention. Marta — can you capture that from the customer during the dry-run?

marta-sales: Will do. Schedule request: propose 30-min dry-run tomorrow 14:00 PT. @dan-security @emma-legal can you make it? I'll send calendar invite with dial-in and presigned S3 link.

emma-legal: I can join for first 20 min. Approve sharing SOC2 artifact with redactions as long as we mark them and keep notes.

dan-security: I can make 14:00 PT. I'll bring the pen-test scope doc.

marta-sales: Thanks all. I'll send invite + tentative quote once Alex shares template. I'll update thread when invite sent.
